title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 25: Protect Your Peace

scenes.say: A Jersey street. A mural of Roddy. Under it: He gave all.
scenes.visual: a street mural of a soldier with the words He gave all, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali touches it. Keeps walking. Hand over heart.
scenes.visual: a man walking past a mural with hand over heart, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Another mural. His face, army gear and a hoodie. Hoodlum Soldier. Protect your peace.
scenes.visual: a mural of a soldier in a hoodie on a brick wall, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The cemetery. Ali kneels at Roddy's grave. A folded flag. A photo of the squad.
scenes.visual: a man kneeling at a grave with a folded flag and a photo, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Some stories don't end happy. But they end honest. And sometimes that's enough.
scenes.visual: a salute at a grave, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A veterans memorial at sunset. His daughter asks: You miss them?
scenes.visual: a father and daughter placing flowers at a memorial at sunset, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Every day. But I carry them in every step I take.
scenes.visual: a father and daughter walking away hand in hand at sunset, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a man standing on a city rooftop at sunset, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I fought wars in foreign lands, and in my own mind.
scenes.visual: the city skyline glowing orange, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: But the real victory was choosing to heal.
scenes.visual: the sun setting over the skyline, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: This was Hoodlum Soldier. Follow at Hoodstar365. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a golden sky over the city at dusk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 25 of 25: Protect Your Peace. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
